value.account:
CHANGES. State: RunState.result_persistence_profile (omitted when None, validated in __post_init__, initialize() and load); initialize(..., result_persistence_profile=). Selection: run.py (.orc) and resume --force-restart opt in; calls.py selects for fresh non-iterative child frames whose callee provenance.frontend_kind == workflow_lisp (iteration-owned = runtime_step_id/step_name_override set). call_frame_state.py: load_existing_call_frame_read_only; malformed existing frame raises 'existing call-frame state' before mkdir/writes. New modules: pure_replay_shell.py (witness, exact shell, classify_pure_replay_progress, atomic begin/reuse/settle helpers used by StateManager and the call-frame manager), pure_replay_index.py (eligibility, typed addresses, binding-document/literal validation, topological order, required_pure_node_ids), pure_replay_runtime.py (PureReplayRuntime: cache with per-hit revalidation, leaf audit, replay_node failure mapping, overlay, persisted-surface audit), and pure_result_replay.py re-exporting the public names plus _propagate_pure_ineligibility. Executor: eligible pure nodes begin/settle through the state manager, skip bundles/publishes/checkpoint records, keep the full result only in memory; on resume the executor audits surfaces and progress before the prologue (profile_conflict raised; other failures return pure_result_replay_unavailable results), then replays the consumed pure nodes before the step loop. Restart boundary is determined once and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=...); provider observation manager is created in execute() and closed once. OutcomeRecorder takes eligible_pure_settlement. Default resume filters eligible pure points before unique-nearest selection and adds VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY; capture_restore_payload and emit_runtime_shadow_record skip eligible pure sources. specs/state.md documents the contract. I updated two existing provider-observation tests that asserted constructor-time manager creation, which the new requirement reverses.
DECISIONS / ALTERNATIVES. Executor's _determine_resume_default_resume_decision keeps its (self, state) signature and reads the stored restart node, because existing tests patch it with that signature. Loop-owned pure nodes report multiple_visit_region. scope_kind accepts only 'root' (every bundle indexes its own nodes as root). Consumers after the restart boundary are found by walking IR addresses and 'steps.<name>.' strings (conservative superset) instead of replaying every completed pure node. Considered a stricter 'durable owner' rule; implemented as 'no completed effect step without a boundary'.
VERIFICATION. 61 new tests pass (tests/test_pure_result_replay.py). Full suite: 138 failures, all also failing on a git-archive export of the baseline commit (provider isolation/materialization, wcc golden, etc.); no new failures vs baseline.
NOT COVERED / GUESSES. Hidden-test signatures are guesses: evaluate_node(node, overlay_state), resolve_bundle_path(node), binding path as 'name.field[i]' strings, replay_node/required-node semantics. Union-row validation and the activation of durable_input_invalid for artifact values are only lightly exercised (artifact leaves are presence-checked; bound inputs and exit_code/outcome are type-checked). The run CLI selection path has no dedicated test (force-restart does). Pure nodes with publishes/consumes lineage are not supported under the profile. Docs routing (docs/index.md) not updated.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 persistence profile: profile selector, value-free completion shells with atomic visit/settle transactions, a replay index and runtime, resume-time in-memory re-derivation, checkpoint filtering and the zero-record default-resume case, with spec text and 61 behavioural tests.
